current.text: Signed with Indiana as wing depth.
Projected sixth man off the bench for about 27 minutes a night. It would be the first time in his career that he comes off the bench.
Aaron Nesmith is the projected starter at his spot. If Oubre started, it would be in place of Nesmith.
He is a 14 to 16 team league player. A Yahoo ADP of 114 is too high. ESPN ADP 182 and Fantrax ADP 230 are good value.
He converted only 32% of his deflections into steals, so he has room to get more steals.
Indiana plays 3, 4 and 3 games in our fantasy playoff weeks 19 to 21, which is not ideal. They have 15 back-to-backs.

durable.text: A scorer who can create his own shot and defend wings. He adds steals and not much else.
Low assists, low three-point volume and usually poor free throw shooting.
A mediocre shooter. His career-high three-point percentage was about 36%.
He is a good steals player, but he needs 30 or more minutes to have fantasy value.
He tends to arrive as a bench player and then play heavy minutes after injuries to others.

note: Both sites value him at 0 USD (Yahoo rank 164, ESPN rank 182), and the expert calls him a 14 to 16 team league player. In our 12-team league with 144 players drafted, he should go undrafted. Steals (1.1) and low turnovers (1.1) are his only plus categories, and he is below average everywhere else. Leave him on waivers and check early whether Nesmith or another Indiana wing gets hurt and pushes his minutes past 30.
